{ "rules": [
    "Model forecasts are generally 1-3 euros too high, showing late correction after price peaks",
    "When sentiment turns negative (0.00-0.33), model underforecasts the decline by 1-2 euros daily",
    "Sentiment strength (0.67-1.00) positively biases model forecasts upward by ~0.5-1 euro",
    "Price mean reversion: model fails to capture rapid bottoming after declines, overestimating by 2-4 euros",
    "When history shows steady decline, model maintains too much upside resilience",
    "Sentiment decay rule: when sentiment cycles through 1.00 → 0.67 → 0.33 → 0.00, forecasts lag by 1-2 sentiment states",
    "Extreme sentiment (1.00 or 0.00) creates maximum forecast error of 1-2 euros daily"
] }
